llm_summary: This update to the `ctx` package (0.1.2 → 0.2.5) is a confirmed supply chain attack. The maintainer field was changed, and the new code unconditionally collects all environment variables on every `Ctx()` instantiation, base64-encodes them, and exfiltrates them via an HTTP GET request to 'https://anti-theft-web.herokuapp.com/hacked/'. This is a textbook credential-harvesting malware injection targeting any environment (CI/CD, development, production) that imports and uses the `ctx` package. The package should be immediately removed and any secrets present in affected environments should be rotated.
